details.thirdSong: He Leadeth Me! O Blessed Thought #052

list: A big THANK YOU to the Church for the $1150.00 that was donated toward the Christmas Shoebox Ministry this year. We greatly appreciate the support.
Women on Mission will meet Monday, September 14 in the Lewis Fellowship Hall at 6:00 PM. Anna Collins will present the program, and Linda Baker will provide the food.
The last Beech Creek Round Up for Christ of the year is Wednesday, September 30.
The Eliza Broadus State mission offering goal is $2,500.

fighterVerse.text: And God is able to make all grace abound toward you; that ye, always having all sufficiency in all things, may abound to every good work.
